description: Send one step: action (what you did; for web include url and title), observation, command (with output and ok or exit_code), edit (with files: path, change, diff), test (with ok and output), decision (what you chose and why), milestone, note or error. The response includes new comments from watchers.

text.description: e.g. "Added the Stripe webhook route" or "Clicked Add to cart"

name: broadcast_step
title: Broadcast a step
